items.markdown:
Customer experience (CX) is `the cumulative perception, emotion, and reaction a customer has during every interaction with a brand, product, or service` —from first discovery through purchase, use, and ongoing support.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Customer_experience)[[2]](https://www.zendesk.com/blog/customer-experience/relationships/why-companies-should-invest-in-the-customer-experience/)[[3]](https://www.cmswire.com/customer-experience/what-is-customer-experience-cx-a-comprehensive-guide/)

### Core Elements of CX

- **Holistic Journey:** It spans online browsing, store visits, marketing messages, checkout flows, product performance, and customer service.[[1]](https://www.oracle.com/cx/what-is-cx/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OPtmFcHNyOs&t=36)
- **CX vs. Customer Service:** Customer service is just one reactive piece of the puzzle, whereas CX represents the entire end-to-end relationship and feeling toward a brand.[[1]](https://www.zendesk.com/blog/customer-experience/relationships/why-companies-should-invest-in-the-customer-experience/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OPtmFcHNyOs&t=36)
- **Business Impact:** Great CX drives customer loyalty, higher retention, positive word-of-mouth, and increased revenue, with many studies showing consumers view experience as important as the product itself.[[1]](https://www.salesforce.com/cx/what-is-customer-experience/)[[2]](https://www.zendesk.com/blog/customer-experience/relationships/why-companies-should-invest-in-the-customer-experience/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NyqluJve3MM)

### Key Metrics Used to Measure CX

- **CSAT (Customer Satisfaction Score):** Measures how much a customer likes a specific interaction or purchase.
- **NPS (Net Promoter Score):** Tracks how likely a customer is to recommend the brand to others.
- **CES (Customer Effort Score):** Evaluates how easy or difficult it was for the customer to resolve an issue or complete a task.[[1]](https://www.zendesk.com/blog/customer-experience/relationships/why-companies-should-invest-in-the-customer-experience/)

### Top Strategies for Improvement

- **Omnichannel Consistency:** Ensuring smooth, connected experiences whether a customer switches from a mobile app to a live chat or an in-store counter.
- **AI & Automation:** Using artificial intelligence tools, chatbots, and real-time analytics to personalize journeys and reduce wait times.
- **Employee Alignment:** Supporting employee experience (EX), because engaged and happy employees naturally deliver better service to customers.[[1]](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/customer-experience)[[2]](https://www.zendesk.com/blog/customer-experience/relationships/why-companies-should-invest-in-the-customer-experience/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OPtmFcHNyOs&t=36)[[4]](https://www.cmswire.com/customer-experience/what-is-customer-experience-cx-a-comprehensive-guide/)[[5]](https://www.medallia.com/experience-101/customer-experience/)

You can learn more about how brands build these strategies through guides like [Zendesk's Customer Experience Overview](https://www.zendesk.com/blog/customer-experience/relationships/why-companies-should-invest-in-the-customer-experience/) and [Forbes Advisor on CX](https://www.forbes.com/advisor/business/customer-experience-cx/).[[1]](https://www.zendesk.com/blog/customer-experience/relationships/why-companies-should-invest-in-the-customer-experience/)[[2]](https://www.forbes.com/advisor/business/customer-experience-cx/)If you'd like to dive deeper, let me know:

- What **industry or type of business** you are working with
- Whether you want to focus on **measuring metrics** (like NPS or CSAT) or **redesigning a customer journey**
